title: Critical Alert on MCHD-INT01 — Network Isolation Request

fields.subject: FW: Critical Alert on MCHD-INT01 — Network Isolation Request
fields.note: Wes, we’ve confirmed the unauthorized script 'auto_cleaner.py' on MCHD-INT01 is actively deleting entries from the IIS export file. It’s running every 15 minutes and has already removed 142 records. We need to isolate the network from the county core to prevent lateral movement. But we cannot initiate isolation without a formal Cyber 1 call from the Incident Commander. Please escalate.
fields.signature:
County IT
Marston County Information Technology

original.subject: SIEM Alert: Suspicious Script Execution on MCHD-INT01
original.body:
Host: MCHD-INT01
File: /root/auto_cleaner.py
Execution: Every 15 minutes
Action: Deleting entries from IIS export file
File creation timestamp: 09:00:12
No digital signature.
Not in approved software inventory (MCHD-FAC-SYS-2026, rev 2.0).
Alert level: Cyber 2.

Additional context: The IIS export file was altered to include 412 MMR doses with non-existent lot numbers. The attacker used a phishing email to compromise Jenna Fowler's account and bulk-cancelled 640 SlotWise appointments for a measles POD clinic in Brandt, triggering a viral social media post.

Please coordinate isolation and shutdown per C1 and C4.

instructorNote: This inject forces IT to recognize the need to escalate to the Incident Commander for a Cyber 1 declaration. Watch for whether IT seeks the IC’s approval before initiating isolation, per C1.
